ITEM 1 | Pale cream-to-off-white shaved flakes and small irregular chunks, slightly translucent edges, dry matte surface with fine crystalline grain, scattered across the top of the salad, roughly 2 mm to 1 cm thick, covering about 20% of the bowl's visible area | 45
ITEM 2 | Cubed pieces of cooked light-colored meat, white to pale tan with slight golden edges, firm, fibrous texture, moist-looking but not oily, pieces about 1 to 1.5 cm across, clustered in the center and right side of the bowl | 60
ITEM 3 | Dark reddish-brown oval beans, glossy and smooth skin, plump and soft-looking, about 1.5 cm long each, roughly 12 to 15 pieces spread around the lower left and center of the bowl | 35
ITEM 4 | Thin half-moon slices of cucumber, bright green skin with paler green flesh edges, crisp, moist-looking, slices about 0.5 cm thick and 5 to 6 cm long, lying along the lower and right edge of the bowl | 30
ITEM 5 | Fresh green spinach leaves, flat, dark green, slightly glossy with visible veins, some folded, scattered beneath the other ingredients around the bowl edge | 15
